content.short: Ellipal is a 100% air-gapped hardware wallet that stores private keys on the device and uses a smartphone app to scan QR codes for transactions.
content.description: Ellipal is a fully air-gapped hardware wallet that keeps private keys securely on the device and never connects to the internet directly. It pairs with a companion smartphone app for everyday use, while critical actions stay on the hardware. Transactions are signed on the device and transmitted to the app by scanning a QR code, so online activity occurs only through the QR workflow. Supported networks include Ethereum, Solana, BNB Chain, Aptos, Sui, Polygon, Arbitrum, and Avalanche.
content.meta: Ellipal is the world's first 100% air-gapped hardware wallet. Discover Ellipal and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
